name: Spotify Play Count Scraper
title: Spotify Play Count Scraper: Tracks, Albums, Artists, Playlists
uses: Labels, managers and A&R teams tracking exact stream counts for tracks and albums
Artists checking monthly listeners, followers, world rank and top cities
Music marketers measuring campaign impact on play counts over time
AI agents answering how many plays a song or album has on Spotify

inputs.name: startUrls
inputs.title: Spotify URLs or URIs
inputs.description: Track, album, artist or playlist links (open.spotify.com/...) or URIs (spotify:track:...). Mix types freely.

inputs.name: maxTracksPerInput
inputs.title: Max tracks per album or playlist
inputs.description: Caps how many track rows each album or playlist returns.

inputs.name: includeAlbumSummary
inputs.title: Add a free album summary row
inputs.description: For album inputs, also output one album row with total play count across all tracks (not charged).

description: Get exact Spotify play counts for any track, album, artist or playlist. Returns stream counts per track, album totals, artist monthly listeners, followers, world rank, top cities and top tracks. No login, no proxy, $0.001 per track.
